title: We Are the Picks and Axes: Selling the Infrastructure That Makes AI Actually Work
summary: Joe Simpson discusses navigating enterprise sales through an IPO, private equity acquisition, leadership transitions, and product evolution toward AI-ready data infrastructure at Alteryx. The conversation covers positioning, buy vs. build decisions, and changing buying behaviors.
keyQuote: Total BS. The cream is gonna rise to the crop. It's not about the LLM, it's what you do with it.
guestBio: Director of Enterprise Sales at Alteryx with 11 years at the company, leading field Account Executives across the West Coast. Has navigated the company through an IPO, private equity acquisition, leadership transitions, and product evolution toward AI-ready data infrastructure.
takeaways: AI's integration into Enterprise Sales strategies
